tools.name: get_funding_rates
tools.description: Live perpetual futures funding rates for one coin across up to 6 venues (Hyperliquid, Binance, Bybit, Pacifica, Extended, Lighter), normalized to hourly rate and simple APR %. Free.

tools.name: find_funding_arbitrage
tools.description: Cross-venue funding-rate spreads: for each coin on 2+ venues, the lowest-funding (long) venue vs highest-funding (short) venue and the APR spread. Free: top 3. With a KLane Pro or trial key (x-api-key header): full list up to 100 and min_oi_usd filter.

tools.name: get_funding_history
tools.description: Hourly funding history for a coin on Hyperliquid (and Bybit when reachable) for the last N days (max 30) with average APR. Requires a KLane Pro key or a free 3-day trial key (x-api-key header).
